SHARD PICKAXE
SHARD SERIES
The '''Shard Pickaxe''', formerly '''Amethyst Pickaxe,''' also called the 'drill' is an shard tool that '''breaks up to nine blocks at once.''' It's considered the most useful item as it can help many tasks that require a lot of mining. It's used to hunt for bases, create holes, mine, and more. It has the same mining speed and durability of a maxed out Netherite pickaxe. As any shard tool, '''this item has a self destruction timer of 1 day (formerly 3).''' Players tend to auction flip gear like this. This used to be '''obtained from the now removed [[Amethyst Crate]]''', and can only be obtained from [[Auction House]] or buying from the shard shop for 3k shards.
